svg.aria-label: Four rows, each a problem and what Budgit does. The problems: three Monday asks are forgotten, the limit is nearly spent on Thursday, a feature called done never ran, and rules live in the prompt where the model can forget them. What Budgit does: a ledger keeps the asks, four levels pace the week, a fresh reviewer tests before done, and guards are scripts
